title: List the French foreign names of all black-bordered cards that are legal in
question: List the French foreign names of all black-bordered cards that are legal in the 'commander' format and either have full artwork or were illustrated by Matthew D. Wilson.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T3."XCL_079"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_082"
WHERE T2."XCL_084" = 'commander'
  AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND T1."XCL_005" = 'black'
  AND (T1."XCL_018" LIKE '%extendedart%' OR T1."XCL_002" = 'Matthew D. Wilson')
  AND T3."XCL_077" = 'French'
